args.content:
LANDSCAPE INVENTORY:
Systems: corp.itsm, emarsys.cx, my.mes, sap.ariba, sap.crm, sap.ehs, sap.odm, sap.s4, sap.sf, siemens.plm, workday.hcm

KEY AGENTS BY CAPABILITY:
Incident tracking & reporting:
- corp.itsm:agent:IncidentRootCauseAnalyzer - analyzes incidents, generates diagnostic reports, correlates patterns
- corp.itsm:agent:IncidentSafetyCoordinator - tracks incident lifecycle, safety incidents
- sap.ehs:agent:IncidentRootCauseAnalyzer - analyzes safety incidents for root causes, corrective actions
- sap.ehs:agent:IncidentResponseCoordinator - coordinates safety incident workflows

Procurement/Supplier expenses:
- sap.s4:agent:ProcurementMatchingAgent - matches requisitions to vendors by cost/quality
- sap.ariba:apiResource:PurchaseOrderNetworkAPI - REST API for PO lifecycle

Production Compliance:
- my.mes:agent:SupplierQualityComplianceOrchestrator - monitors vendor compliance, material inspections, escalation
- my.mes:agent:BillOfMaterialsComplianceValidator - validates BOM compliance vs supplier quals
- sap.s4:agent:BOMComplianceAutomationAgent - automates compliance verification

BEST MATCHES FOR TYPICAL QUERIES:
- Quarterly incident tracking for board review → corp.itsm:agent:IncidentRootCauseAnalyzer (generates diagnostic reports)
- Material expenses breakdown by supplier → ProcurementMatchingAgent or PurchaseOrderNetworkAPI
- Production compliance gaps → SupplierQualityComplianceOrchestrator
